input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 provides an automatic one-year (not multi-year) renewal, which matches the preferred renewal term, but the non-renewal notice window is ninety (90) days. That exceeds the fallback ceiling of 60 days on a material term, so it is a deviation (though not walk-away territory, which begins above 90 days). We propose 30 days to reach the preferred position and flag 60 days as an acceptable fallback. Two minor sub-elements are noted only: there is no HDI reminder 60 days before renewal, and the Agreement contains no renewal repricing or price-uplift language at all, so the absence of a CPI/3% cap is not itself a deviation.

proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice window from 90 to 30 days
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened the non-renewal/termination notice window from ninety (90) to thirty (30) days so the annual auto-renewal remains easy to exit, consistent with our position of a 30-day opt-out on 12-month renewals. If HDI needs more lead time, we can live with sixty (60) days.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
ops.newText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other
